q1.prompt: Name an English word with a letter-value sum of at most 254 points. (A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26.)
q1.metric: Sum of alphabetic A1Z26 letter values
q1.metric_provenance: Each distinct A–Z headword in the union of CMU Pronouncing Dictionary 1.1.3 and SCOWL-derived Hunspell en_US 2020.12.07-4 (including affix-rule inflections) was independently rescored with the bundled C++17 algorithm. Coverage is source-defined, not every imaginable English neologism.
q1.measurement_snapshot: Frozen local cmudict 1.1.3 and hunspell-en-us 1:2020.12.07-4; identity vocabulary frozen on 2026-10-21

measurement.numeric_rule: Only A-Z alphabetic spellings; ignore source pronunciation variants, deduplicate case-insensitively; exact positive integer letter weights. Hunspell inflections derived from explicitly licensed suffix/prefix flags and cross-products.

answer_scope.entity_scope: All unique ASCII A-Z words in CMU 1.1.3, Hunspell US dictionary, plus Hunspell affix-rule wordforms. Proper names may appear through CMU.
answer_scope.note: All words in the frozen union are scored; a legitimate English word not found in either source may require manual verification.

q1.scoring_policy: From below, all source-eligible words scored; 0 for wrong side or outside 39-letter-point window.
q1.research_status: Imported and numerically audited. Editorial acceptance depends on coverage/provenance limits.
q1.prompt_note: A1Z26 is computed deterministically for each word. Source version is fixed for the daily challenge.

eligibility_rule.category_definition: Must be present in the frozen CMU + Hunspell union; all letters A-Z, including names from CMU; no numeric strings or made-up words.
